title: Charge sign determination
description: Essential: Student must correctly identify the particle as positively charged, based on the direction of forces in the velocity selector.

title: Charge-to-mass ratio
description: Essential: Student must derive and present the final expression for q/m, which is E₁²/(2UB₁²).

title: OP distance calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly calculate the distance OP as 4UB₁/(E₁B₂).

title: Velocity at O'
description: Essential: Student must determine the final velocity at point O' as (2E₂ - E₁)/B₁.

title: Velocity selector equilibrium
description: Important: Student must apply the force balance condition (qvB₁ = qE₁) to find the velocity v₀ entering the selector.

title: Energy conservation in accelerator
description: Important: Student must use the work-energy theorem (qU = ½mv₀²) to relate acceleration voltage to initial velocity.

title: Circular motion in separator
description: Important: Student must apply the Lorentz force as centripetal force (qv₀B₂ = mv₀²/r) to find the radius of curvature.

title: Velocity superposition analysis
description: Important: For part (3), student must correctly analyze the superposition of velocities when the electric field changes to E₂.

title: Sign/direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly determines charge polarity or misapplies right-hand rule for force directions.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student demonstrates dimensional analysis or unit verification of final expressions.
